observed_problem.unsafe_abstraction: state_roles selects a semantic role such as charm but does not name the source-derived component that may occupy it
observed_problem.risk: A future recording, charging, question or sleep source could be silently substituted by an unrelated same-role component.

required_recovery: A non-entry registered-state score step that selects a role must also declare a unique state_components list of exact registered component IDs.
Composition selects only those named components from the source sustain frame and replaces the corresponding entry role; it must reject unknown or unselected IDs.
The sustain step must name every source component it uses, and score/browser audits must expose the selected component IDs.
The legacy score remains fail-closed until its special sources have completed their source-specific acceptance path.
forbidden: automatic selection of another charm variant
old special-art fallback or daily-face completion
whole-face replacement, runtime activation, external-NOR provisioning, firmware flash or physical acceptance
